articles.title: In 2026, scientists recreated 15,000 years of solar wind exposure on Moon soil in 4 hours; the experiment could help with future lunar resource mining
articles.description: Interlune has recreated the effects of around 15,000 years of solar-wind exposure on lunar soil in just four hours, using accelerated helium ions inside a vacuum chamber. The experiment created a gas-bearing lunar soil simulant that could help companies test equipment for extracting helium-3 and other resources on Earth before sending mining technology to the Moon. The development addresses a major challenge in lunar research, where genuine Apollo soil is extremely limited and conventional simulants do not contain solar-wind gases.

articles.title: Iran’s deadliest proxy unleashes fury: Mojtaba-backed Houthis hunt Saudi-backed forces on camera
articles.description: Iran-backed Houthi forces have released previously unseen footage that they say shows an attack on Saudi-backed Yemeni forces. The visuals provide a rare glimpse into the reported operation and show what Houthi fighters describe as the detection of a “complex” of opposing forces. Following the reported discovery, missiles and drones were launched against targets in several areas. The footage appears to show a coordinated strike involving multiple attack vectors, highlighting the growing use of drones and missiles in Yemen’s conflict. The release comes amid continued regional tensions involving Iran, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, and armed groups operating across the Middle East.
